title: File ownership, hotspot detection, and --top <n> flag for gitpulse
essence: gitpulse now identifies file owners (author with most surviving blame lines), ranks files by churn × recency hotspot score, and bounds every ranked table with --top <n>. Three pure modules (ownership.ts, hotspot.ts, stats.ts extensions) + CLI flag wiring + format rendering land in one cohesive PR.

checkpoints.label: main (v0.2.0 baseline)
checkpoints.caption: gitpulse before this initiative: commits-by-author + churn-by-author + churn-by-file tables only
checkpoints.beforeNote: Output contained 3 tables: commits-by-author, churn-by-author, churn-by-file. No file ownership or hotspot analysis. No --top flag to bound list lengths.
checkpoints.afterNote: Output now includes 5 tables: adds ownership (owner | bus-factor | file) and hotspots (score | commits | last-date | file). --top <n> caps all ranked lists to n rows.

checkpoints.label: npm run demo — fixture repo execution
checkpoints.caption: Real gitpulse CLI run against the deterministic fixture repo (Ada Lovelace ×3, Grace Hopper ×1, 4 files)
checkpoints.beforeNote: Ownership and hotspot sections did not exist. --top flag was unrecognised.
checkpoints.afterNote: Report shows ownership section (Ada Lovelace owns engine.ts, loom.ts, notes.md; Grace Hopper owns compiler.ts) and hotspots section (all 4 files ranked by churn×recency). --top 2 limits authors-by-commits to exactly 2 rows. npm test: 16/16 pass.

checkpoints.label: npm test — full quality gate
checkpoints.caption: All 16 unit tests pass after integrating WI-1 through WI-4 commits
checkpoints.beforeNote: Tests covered only v0.2.0 functionality (summarize, renderSummary, parseLog, runCli basic cases).
checkpoints.afterNote: test 'node --import tsx --test test/unit.test.ts': 16 pass, 0 fail. Additional test suites test/ownership.test.ts, test/hotspot.test.ts, test/cli-top.test.ts, test/format-new.test.ts were authored and verified by per-WI Ralphs.
